rewrite: Every v2 schema file is copied with its $id under /mosaic-event/3/ and both schemaVersion consts (envelope and start messageMetadata) set to mosaic-event/3.

Every v2 case keeps its id, kind, verdict and source; its fixture is the v2 fixture with the string mosaic-event/3 replaced by mosaic-event/4 first, then mosaic-event/2 by mosaic-event/3. The wrong-version probes (invalid-wrong-version, invalid-envelope-wrong-version, invalid-v2-envelope-wrong-version-v3) therefore carry mosaic-event/4 here; the -v1 copies keep mosaic-event/1.
invalid-wrong-version-v2 and invalid-envelope-wrong-version-v2 are the -v1 probes with mosaic-event/2.
Capture provenance stays in the v1 provenance.json; v2 additions are described in the v2 provenance.json.
additions: data-usage: optional contextTokens and contextWindow (safe integers >= 0): the harness reported context in use and the model's context window. Absent means unknown.

data-session-controls (new data part): {mode, maxMode, model?, effort?}; mode and maxMode are one of read_only, ask, auto_edits, full_auto; model matches ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:\[\]-]{0,127}$ and effort ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$ (the archivist daemon's modelIDRe and effortRe). Wired into chunk.json and into the envelope for the daemon and chat-api origins, like data-usage.
Synthetic valid and invalid cases for both additions (ids *-v3-*).
